title: RCT
details: A randomised controlled trial. The project is in sprint, but its Drive folder holds no files yet — no protocol or data has been uploaded. Work is tracked in the Agile Tracker while the folder is empty.

title: Slum
details: Studies slum health, led by Farhana and Nazmul. The folder holds the protocol for a dengue KAP and environmental risk study in Mirpur, covering knowledge, attitudes and practices around dengue and environmental risk. The protocol is the current working document.

title: DayCare
details: Studies day care, led by Jannat and Nazmul. Ruhina Ghani supports the project as an expert. The folder holds the full research protocol on 24-hour movement behaviours, organised questionnaires in English and Bangla, and a Kobo questionnaire file. Data collection runs through KoboToolbox.

description: Research on social media and health.
title: Social Media
details: Studies social media and health, led by Mahadi. The project is in sprint, but its Drive folder holds no files yet — no protocol, questionnaire or data has been uploaded. Work is tracked in the Agile Tracker while the folder is empty.

description: Research on Rohingya health, including waterborne disease.
title: Rohinga
details: Studies Rohingya health, including waterborne disease, led by Mahmudul Hasan and Shaukat. The folder holds the health-camp questionnaire, the Kobo data export on determinants of waterborne disease, and the full diarrhoea results file. Data collection at the health camps is done and results are in hand.

title: Systematic Review
details: A systematic review, led by Naimul. The project is in sprint, but its Drive folder holds no files yet — no protocol, search results or extraction sheets have been uploaded. Work is tracked in the Agile Tracker while the folder is empty.

title: Mental Health (DGME)
details: Mental health research with the Directorate General of Medical Education, led by Naimul. The folder holds the DGME research protocol, the baseline multi-centre cross-sectional study on prevalence and psychosocial correlates among Bangladeshi university students, and the explainable multimodal AI-based early risk assessment platform. IRB and ERB approvals, budgets, CVs, NIDs and participant lists are filed alongside the data folders.

title: Antibiotic
details: Work on antibiotics, led by Sadia Mehjabeen Kanta. The folder holds the updated antibiotic KAP questionnaire and the BMRC document, so the survey instrument is ready. Data collection and analysis follow from the questionnaire.

title: Meseal
details: Research on measles, led by Shaukat and Halimuzzaman. The project is in sprint, but its Drive folder holds no files yet — no protocol or data has been uploaded. The tracker marks this project at write-up stage, so work is tracked in the Agile Tracker while the folder is empty.

description: Analysis of MICS survey data — digital inequality and foundational learning.
title: Mics Data
details: Analysis of MICS survey data, led by Shaukat. The current analysis topic is digital inequality and foundational learning, worked on by Antu and Shanzida. The project is in sprint, but its Drive folder holds no files yet — no datasets or analysis files have been uploaded. Work is tracked in the Agile Tracker while the folder is empty.

title: Cumilla Research
description: Research in Cumilla — three studies (Cumilla Research 1–3).
details: Research in Cumilla — three studies (Cumilla Research 1–3), led by Naimul Islam. The folder holds a research grant document for BCCP, the funding proposal behind the studies. The project sits in the backlog while the grant work proceeds.

title: University Student
description: Analysis of university student data — two studies (University Student 1–2).
details: Analysis of university student data — two studies (University Student 1–2), led by Naimul Islam. The folder holds the questionnaire, Kobo data files and a primary analysis folder, plus a STROBE checklist for reporting. Data and analysis files are in place for the write-up.

title: Tobacco
details: Tobacco-related research, led by Naimul Islam. The folder holds the study protocol, which sets out the research plan. The project sits in the backlog while the protocol is the current working document.

title: HIV Analysis
description: HIV analysis - subgroup research on people who inject drugs and people living with HIV.
details: New HIV subgroup (Nov 2026): team Nazmul, Tanzim Ahmed Sakib, Ayon, Kausar Niaz and Salauddin. Primary plan is eight papers - five on people who inject drugs and three on people living with HIV (ART adherence, quality of life on ART, and treatment outcomes on ART).

title: Myopia
details: Myopia analysis project, team Borhan and Ruksi. A single research entry - conference papers and submissions are not listed separately.
